Concept
Software. Our Bread & Butter.

What catnip is to cats and what bad decisions are to Britain's government, software is to Syndromatic. We obsess over the most minute details in our software, whether it be an icon's textures or an app's animations and fluidity. We think this is what sets our software a generation apart from the industry, and if you have found the website a pleasure to use, then you'll find yourself naturally agreeing with us.

Everything on this page is built in-house: the runtime under your cursor, the launcher you came in through, the controls you are touching and the material language that dresses them. They share one personality because one studio makes them.

Spin the showcase above to see where that work lands: from the SynCloudOS Webspring to the AtmoPad home screen, the SynOS Canora desktop and the OpenXMB shell.
